A cursor on a different filesystem device is refused
reason: The worktree and permitted evidence directory both report device 16777233 via stat -f. The targeted security test covers device metadata mismatches but explicitly skips a real foreign-device file on Darwin. A disposable foreign filesystem cannot be created within the permitted boundary without host-level mount/FUSE changes, which are forbidden. Provide an already-mounted disposable filesystem accessible within the worktree to drive this guard live.
